summary: Traffic mirroring into canary creates duplicate affinity lease leading to intermittent fallback routing
description:
Issue summary:
Traffic mirroring configured for a staged canary caused duplicated affinity lease tokens for a subset of tenant sessions. The duplicated leases intermittently race with the pin-reconciliation routine and the edge fallback policy, resulting in split routing (some requests hit the canary variant, others are routed to the fallback model) and occasional mixed-model outputs for the same session.

Impact:
- Customer (Acme Health, Dedicated) seeing inconsistent model outputs for the same session ID during a 10:00-10:40 UTC window on 2026-03-12.
- User-facing degradation: 5-10% of requests returned fallback variant responses.
- No increased 5xx rate observed, but quality regressions reported by CS.

Environment:
- Prod, us-east-1.
- Canary route: /v1/engines/health-chat-canary
- Mirroring config: edge-proxy mirrors ~8% of live traffic to canary for sampling.

Steps to reproduce (observed in logs):
1) Request arrives at edge with session cookie X-AFFINITY and tenant header X-TENANT-ACME.
2) Edge mirror plugin performs synchronous mirror to canary path while continuing primary path.
3) Mirror flow performs lease refresh and issues a new affinity token for the mirrored stream; original request retains original token.
4) Reconcilers (edge + orchestrator) receive near-simultaneous lease updates; reconciliation race causes two active leases for the session for ~200-800ms.
5) During the race window some subsequent requests are routed according to the newer lease (canary) while others continue to honor the original (primary) leading to mixed responses.

Observed behavior (examples):
- Trace: edge_request_id=abc123 mirror_request_id=abc123-m1 tenant=acme session=acct-901 token_before=aff-7a token_after=aff-7b
- Orchestrator logs: WARN lease-conflict: session acct-901 conflicting-leases=2 duration_ms=420
- Serving runtime: INFO route-selected model=redwood-13b-v1 node=pool-4 fallback_allowed=true

Expected behavior:
- Mirroring should not mutate or issue new affinity leases for mirrored streams. Mirror requests must be read-only from a routing/affinity perspective. Session affinity must remain stable for the primary flow.

Immediate mitigation applied:
- At 2026-03-12T11:05 UTC we patched the edge-mirror plugin to disable lease refreshes on mirrored requests (rollback flag applied) which reduced the duplicated-lease occurrences to near zero.
- Implemented temporary traffic hold: reduced mirror percentage from 8% to 0.5% while we investigate.

Logs and artifacts attached (snippets pasted below):
- edge-log: [2026-03-12T10:07:12Z] edge-proxy: mirror:init session=acct-901 orig-token=aff-7a mirror-lease=aff-7b
- orchestrator: [2026-03-12T10:07:12Z] reconciler: lease-upsert session=acct-901 lease=aff-7b source=mirror
- serving: [2026-03-12T10:07:12Z] selector: selected=redwood-13b-v1 fallback=false

Next steps:
- Engineering to implement a hard guard in edge-mirror: never perform lease-create/refresh for mirrored requests (design doc PR linked below).
- Add an additional reconciliation metric and alert for duplicate-lease-count per tenant.
- Postmortem: draft a short incident report and update mirroring runbook with explicit invariant that mirrors are read-only for routing and affinity.

References:
- Slack thread: #support (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C04ABCDEF)
- Design PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestrator/pull/482
investigation_notes: 03/12 10:30 UTC - Support triaged: reproduced mixed outputs from customer-provided traces.
03/12 11:00 UTC - SRE captured orchestrator reconciler traces showing concurrent lease-upserts for same session.
03/12 11:05 UTC - Deployed edge-mirror rollback flag to stop lease mutations; monitoring shows drop in duplicates.
Hypothesis: mirror code path incorrectly uses session lease API for analytics prewarming; should use read-only session context.
Observed that mirror requests include header X-MIRROR=true but lease creation routine ignored this flag in older edge-proxy builds (v2.12.0).

Riley Chen (SRE) [2026-03-12T11:10Z]: Found lease-upsert collision. Temporary mitigations applied to mirror plugin. Monitoring continuing.
Maya Singh (Serving) [2026-03-13T09:00Z]: Confirmed serving runtime correctly honored routes; root cause upstream at edge/orchestrator. Adding metric for duplicate-leases.

resolution: Mitigation applied: mirror plugin patched to avoid lease creation/refresh on mirrored flows and mirror traffic reduced. Engineering action items created to harden mirror path and add duplicate-lease alert. Customer notified with temporary workaround and timeline for full fix.
